title: ClickXRPFi
tagline: Send XRP, earn DeFi yield automatically. No ETH wallet needed. Yield returns to your XRPL wallet.
description: XRPDeFi Bridge lets XRPL users earn Ethereum DeFi yields without ever touching an ETH wallet. You simply send XRP — a Flare Smart Account intercepts it, swaps it to ETH or USDC via Uniswap, and deposits it into a yield protocol. When it's time to collect, the yield and your original amount are converted back to XRP and returned directly to your XRPL account. Powered by Flare, Uniswap, and Chainlink CCIP — cross-chain yield, made effortless.
how_its_made: XRPDeFi Bridge uses Flare Smart Accounts as the core orchestrator — they intercept incoming XRP payments and act as a non-custodial proxy, no ETH wallet needed. Uniswap API handles the XRP → USDC/ETH swap atomically, which then gets deposited into a yield protocol. Chainlink CCIP manages secure cross-chain messaging between XRPL and Ethereum, solving the hardest part: trustless state sync across two chains.
auto_summary: A cross-chain prototype that records XRPL-linked intents, sends CCIP messages, swaps WETH to USDC, and credits a simple yield vault.
